Name: JojaPantry Canned Goods
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]Let Joja fill your pantry with [b][color=#a4c2f4]JojaPantry[/color][/b]![/quote][/size]
JojaMart's B/C aisle now stocks [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaPantry[/b][/color]™ canned produce and Can Openers at the start of the aisle!

Are you a flower-only farm but still want some "fresh" produce to make your dinner? Just hit Summer but you really want a Parsnip from Spring?
[b]
JojaMart's B/C aisle, as well as the blue pallet in front of them, are now shops!
[u]Check out the images for the exact spots.[/u]
[/b]
• 36 [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaPantry[/b] [b]canned produce[/b][/color]. The varieties offered are [b]unique [/b]to each season!
﻿- The cans for sale will be the[b] current season[/b] and the[b] previous seasons[/b] crops.
﻿- They require a [b]Can Opener[/b] to open!
﻿- Each can contains 1-3 of the indicated produce, plus occasionally... other things. Joja isn't picky about what ends up in the cans...
﻿- The quality of produce is [u]always[/u] [b]Normal [/b]quality.
[b]
If you're a JojaMart Member, all canned produce is sold regardless of season, plus some bonus produce![/b]

• Placeable[color=#6d9eeb] [b]Can Opener [/b][/color](Machine) opens any JojaPantry canned food[b].
[/b] -[b]Eight [/b]table color options pulled from the vanilla spritesheets.
﻿-Only [b]two [/b]variants for sale per season.

• [b][u]OPTIONAL[/u] Canned [color=#e06666]Meats[/color][/b] + [b]Canned [color=#ea9999]Fish [/color][/b]addon[b][color=#a4c2f4].[/color][/b][b]
[/b] -Sold on the left most aisle (see last screenshot)
-Uses the unused base game meat sprites
-Adds [b]2 recipes per meat[/b], so they're not totally useless, also using the unused base game sprites
-Even more [b][u]OPTIONAL[/u] [/b]simple butchery addon that uses these meats. See pinned comment for more info!


Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBites [/url]for TV Dinners, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38939]JojaMills Breakfast[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more snacks!

There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields, or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job!

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Doesn't edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't remove/relocate the aisles.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI, Peachy Objects)

IMPORTANT: Remove previous JojaPantry folder before updating to this!
See changelog for more info!

Optional patch to lower the price of the canned goods by 50%. Requires main file.

This was made for folks playing with 50% or less profit margin, but it's not that unbalanced for Normal profit margin IMO. Install over Main File.

Downloads.Description:
Adds a canned meat/fish section to the left most aisle. Uses the unused base game meat sprites. 2 new recipes for each meat so they're not useless, also using the unused base game sprites. Meat can be put in the dehydrator for jerky.

Meat is pricey!
